p2FamilyPlan.scope: Variable readings; Isaiah and Munda cor meum

p2FamilyPlan.name: 04 Credo
p2FamilyPlan.scope: One Creed owner, not twenty-five essays

p2FamilyPlan.name: 07 Roman Canon doxology
p2FamilyPlan.scope: Per ipsum belongs to 14th Canon owner

p2FamilyPlan.name: 08 Pater, fraction, Pax
p2FamilyPlan.scope: Scripture, rubric and prayer are distinct

p2FamilyPlan.name: 09 Priest and faithful Communion
p2FamilyPlan.scope: Domine non sum dignus, local second Confiteor

p2FamilyPlan.name: 10 Ablutions and Postcommunion
p2FamilyPlan.scope: Quod ore / Corpus tuum, repeated greeting

p2FamilyPlan.name: 11 Dismissal and blessing
p2FamilyPlan.scope: Ite, Placeat, omissions depend on rite

p2FamilyPlan.name: 12 Last Gospel
p2FamilyPlan.scope: Use Scripture reader; no invented universal omission

gate: Retain 44 original bilingual studies and 139 verified claims unchanged.
Ten candidate new details are ten micro-units under seven existing prayers, not ten new mini-articles.
An author discussing a prayer does not automatically certify each derived microphrase or Scripture reference.
All 180 P2 actions in the conversation workbook remain preliminary family routing, not 180 individually collated sources.
Second Confiteor, processional Last Gospel, proper readings and priest/deacon cue ownership remain conditionally gated.
No Mass reader text, UI publication, rubrics or main app changes.
